prompt: Hi, I'm the editorial lead for our morning intelligence digest. I need a curated briefing covering three areas: business & economy, science & technology, and entertainment. Also, please make sure to record my content preferences somewhere so the system can remember them for future requests. We rely on VNExpress as our source.
